init_adaptation.effect_on_comparison: B_W0 vs B_R share an initial state by construction; B_Rwd (old round) cannot be shown to share it, so the wd 1e-2 coordinate is compared with a stated initial-state caveat
init_adaptation.name: deterministic_shared_c1_init
init_adaptation.why: se_train never seeds the process RNG before building the C1 base, so the initial weights differ per process and cannot be shared across arms; build_full_state(seed=0)+remap_state('C1') is the frozen, documented C1 init used by the HOME round's original B arm
